verses.original: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος εἴ τις ὀρέγεται ἐπισκοπῆς ἐπιθυμεῖ καλοῦ ἔργου
verses.transliteration: Pistos ho logos ei tis oregetai episkopēs epithymei kalou ergou
verses.literal: [This is] a trustworthy - saying If anyone aspires to be an overseer he desires a noble task

verses.original: τὸν ἐπίσκοπον οὖν δεῖ εἶναι ἀνεπίλημπτον ἄνδρα μιᾶς γυναικὸς νηφάλιον σώφρονα κόσμιον φιλόξενον διδακτικόν
verses.transliteration: ton episkopon oun dei einai anepilēmpton andra mias gynaikos nēphalion sōphrona kosmion philoxenon didaktikon
verses.literal: An overseer then must be above reproach [the] husband of but one wife temperate self-controlled respectable hospitable able to teach

verses.original: μὴ πάροινον μὴ πλήκτην ἀλλὰ ἐπιεικῆ ἄμαχον ἀφιλάργυρον
verses.transliteration: mē paroinon mē plēktēn alla epieikē amachon aphilargyron
verses.literal: not dependent on wine not violent but gentle peaceable [and] free of the love of money

verses.original: προϊστάμενον τοῦ ἰδίου οἴκου καλῶς ἔχοντα τέκνα ἐν ὑποταγῇ μετὰ πάσης σεμνότητος
verses.transliteration: proistamenon tou idiou oikou kalōs echonta tekna en hypotagē meta pasēs semnotētos
verses.literal: [An overseer must] manage [his] own household well [and] keep [his] children under control with complete dignity

verses.original: δέ εἰ τις οὐκ οἶδεν πῶς προστῆναι τοῦ ἰδίου οἴκου ἐπιμελήσεται ἐκκλησίας Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de ei tis ouk oiden pōs prostēnai tou idiou oikou epimelēsetai ekklēsias Theou
verses.literal: [For] if someone {does} not know how to manage [his] own household [how] can he care for [the] church of God

verses.original: μὴ νεόφυτον ἵνα μὴ τυφωθεὶς ἐμπέσῃ εἰς κρίμα τοῦ διαβόλου
verses.transliteration: mē neophyton hina mē typhōtheis empesē eis krima tou diabolou
verses.literal: [He must] not [be] a recent convert vvv vvv or he may become conceited [and] fall under [ the same ] condemnation as the devil

verses.original: δὲ καὶ δεῖ ἔχειν καλὴν μαρτυρίαν ἀπὸ τῶν ἔξωθεν ἵνα μὴ ἐμπέσῃ εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν καὶ παγίδα τοῦ διαβόλου
verses.transliteration: de kai dei echein kalēn martyrian apo tōn exōthen hina mē empesē eis oneidismon kai pagida tou diabolou
verses.literal: Furthermore . . . he must have a good reputation with vvv outsiders so that vvv he will not fall into disgrace and [into the] snare of the devil

verses.original: Διακόνους ὡσαύτως σεμνούς μὴ διλόγους μὴ προσέχοντας πολλῷ οἴνῳ μὴ αἰσχροκερδεῖς
verses.transliteration: Diakonous hōsautōs semnous mē dilogous mē prosechontas pollō oinō mē aischrokerdeis
verses.literal: Deacons likewise [must be] dignified not double-tongued [or] given to much wine [or] greedy for money

verses.original: ἔχοντας τὸ μυστήριον τῆς πίστεως ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει
verses.transliteration: echontas to mystērion tēs pisteōs en kathara syneidēsei
verses.literal: They must hold to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience

verses.original: καὶ δὲ οὗτοι δοκιμαζέσθωσαν πρῶτον εἶτα ὄντες ἀνέγκλητοι διακονείτωσαν
verses.transliteration: kai de houtoi dokimazesthōsan prōton eita ontes anenklētoi diakoneitōsan
verses.literal: Additionally . . . they must first be tested . . . Then if they are above reproach let them serve as deacons

verses.original: ὡσαύτως Γυναῖκας σεμνάς μὴ διαβόλους νηφαλίους πιστὰς ἐν πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: hōsautōs Gynaikas semnas mē diabolous nēphalious pistas en pasin
verses.literal: In the same way [the] women [must be] dignified not slanderers [but] temperate [and] faithful in all things

verses.original: Διάκονοι ἔστωσαν ἄνδρες μιᾶς γυναικὸς καλῶς προϊστάμενοι τέκνων καὶ τῶν ἰδίων οἴκων
verses.transliteration: Diakonoi estōsan andres mias gynaikos kalōs proistamenoi teknōn kai tōn idiōn oikōn
verses.literal: A deacon must be [the] husband of but one wife a good manager [of his] children and [of his] own household

verses.original: γὰρ οἱ διακονήσαντες καλῶς περιποιοῦνται ἑαυτοῖς καλὸν βαθμὸν καὶ πολλὴν παρρησίαν ἐν πίστει τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar hoi diakonēsantes kalōs peripoiountai heautois kalon bathmon kai pollēn parrēsian en pistei tē en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: For those who have served well [as deacons] acquire for themselves a high standing and great confidence in [the] faith that [is] in Christ Jesus

verses.original: ἐλπίζων ἐλθεῖν πρὸς σὲ ἐν τάχει γράφω σοι Ταῦτά
verses.transliteration: elpizōn elthein pros se en tachei graphō soi Tauta
verses.literal: [Although] I hope to come to you vvv soon I am writing you these things

verses.original: δὲ ἐὰν βραδύνω ἵνα εἰδῇς πῶς δεῖ ἀναστρέφεσθαι ἐν Θεοῦ οἴκῳ ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐκκλησία ζῶντος Θεοῦ στῦλος καὶ ἑδραίωμα τῆς ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: de ean bradynō hina eidēs pōs dei anastrephesthai en Theou oikō hētis estin ekklēsia zōntos Theou stylos kai hedraiōma tēs alētheias
verses.literal: - in case I am delayed so that you will know how each one must conduct himself in God’s household which is [the] church of [the] living God [the] pillar and foundation of the truth

verses.original: Καὶ ὁμολογουμένως τὸ μυστήριον τῆς εὐσεβείας ἐστὶν μέγα Ὃς ἐφανερώθη ἐν σαρκί ἐδικαιώθη ἐν πνεύματι ὤφθη ἀγγέλοις ἐκηρύχθη ἐν ἔθνεσιν ἐπιστεύθη ἐν κόσμῳ ἀνελήμφθη ἐν δόξῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai homologoumenōs to mystērion tēs eusebeias estin mega Hos ephanerōthē en sarki edikaiōthē en pneumati ōphthē angelois ekērychthē en ethnesin episteuthē en kosmō anelēmphthē en doxē
verses.literal: vvv By common confession the mystery - of godliness is great [He] appeared in [the] flesh was vindicated by [the] Spirit was seen by angels was proclaimed among [the] nations was believed in throughout [the] world was taken up in glory
